t: Bosch Expert Self Cut Speed spade drill bit for use in softwoods, chipboard or particleboard. Features a self-feeding threaded tip offering high-speed wood drilling with minimal pressure needed. Wave-shaped spade drill bit design delivers fast chip removal. Ideal for drilling upside down or in tight spaces. 1/4” impact-rated hex shank provides maximum power transfer in standard 3-jaw drills and hexagonal screwdriver chucks. 25 x 152mm.
b: Suitable for Natural Hardwood & Softwood, Plywood, Chipboard & Hardboard
For Use with 3-Jaw & 1/4" Hex Chuck Machines on Rotary Action
